# Saved pages

Pages saved from a browser, for writing tests of what the crawl could not see (after a login, after
a form is sent) and for fixing locators after the site changed.

**Where they go:** one folder per page class, named for the date and what the page shows:

```
saved-pages/HomePage/2026-10-01-after-search.html
saved-pages/HomePage/2026-10-01-logged-in.html
saved-pages/NEW-order-confirmation/2026-10-01.html     a page no class covers yet
```

**How to save one:** in Chrome, open the page as the story needs it (logged in, the form filled,
the menu open), then either *Save page as... > Webpage, HTML only*, or open DevTools (F12), right-click
the `<html>` element and *Copy > Copy outerHTML*, and paste it into a `.html` file. The outerHTML
copy has what scripts added after the page loaded; *Save page as* sometimes does not.

**Personal data:** a saved page holds whatever the page showed: names, addresses, order numbers.
Delete or replace it before sharing the folder. .gitignore keeps saved pages out of git; tests never
copy values from them.
